title: Brain activation skill implemented as agent neutral protocol
summary: The brain activation capability has been implemented as an agent-neutral skill. It lives in the project at skills/brain-activation/SKILL.md and has a Codex auto-discovery copy at /Users/imyu/.codex/skills/brain-activation. The skill does not duplicate daemon retrieval; it uses daemon RAG/DAG/detail/frontier tools to infer current product shape, iterate search when context is thin, debate candidate next tasks, define judging metrics, and route promising candidates into measured self-learning experiments.
